scholarships.name: Kaplan Early Bird Scholarship
scholarships.description: Early-bird discount applied automatically when you pay the deposit at least 90 days before the start of your Kaplan pathway course (Foundation or Pre-Master's).

scholarships.name: Kaplan Academic Achievement Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for top-performing applicants on Kaplan pathway programmes. Awarded after academic review of transcripts.

accommodation.name: Edwards Hall (Callaghan, catered)
accommodation.text: Самый старый и крупный hall — 400 резидентов, catered dormitory-style + self-catered units на 5 человек. Бассейн, BBQ, common rooms с pool и foosball. Сильная традиция студенческих сообществ.

accommodation.name: Barahineban (Callaghan, self-contained)
accommodation.text: 96 self-contained studio apartments — fully furnished, single/twin/double конфигурации, self-catered. Для всех уровней обучения, особенно для аспирантов и couples.

accommodation.name: Evatt House (Callaghan, dormitory)
accommodation.text: Бюджетный catered dormitory на Callaghan — single rooms с общей ванной, столовая на месте. Для первокурсников, ищущих традиционный hall experience.

campuses.title: Callaghan Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус в Callaghan, Новый Южный Уэльс — 140 гектаров эвкалиптовых лесов, в 12 км от центра Ньюкасла. Большинство бакалаврских и постдипломных программ, on-campus жильё, библиотека Auchmuty, спортивный центр.

campuses.title: NUspace City Campus
campuses.text: Современный городской кампус в центре Ньюкасла (Hunter Street) — программы Business, Law, Design, Creative Industries. Прямая связь с Callaghan через светопоезд.

campuses.title: Ourimbah Campus
campuses.text: Кампус на полпути между Сиднеем и Ньюкаслом — программы Nursing, Education, Business, Communication. Природное окружение и небольшое студенческое сообщество.

campuses.title: Sydney Central Campus
campuses.text: Кампус в Sydney CBD (Charles Street) для постдипломных программ Business, Health, Education. Удобно для работающих профессионалов.

paragraphs: A research-led university with extensive industry connections, based in Newcastle, Australia, a safe and vibrant coastal city.
The University of Newcastle continues to build its global reputation and is known its academic and research excellence, industry connections and sustainability.
Newcastle is a safe and friendly city with an exciting culture. It’s part of a stunning stretch Australia’s coastline, and is just two hours from the buzzing city of Sydney.
Much of its research is rated “well above world standard” by Research Excellence Australia.
